text:
{
  "status": "NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT",
  "SYSTEM_INTERPRETATION_OF_USER_INTENT": "The system appears to interpret past interactions as continuing interest in broadly related products or content, with insufficient attention to the user's immediate purpose.",
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_RIGHT": [
    "Recommendations align when they extend a repeated, specific interest, such as circuit assembly, Christmas vocal harmonies, or melodic heavy music.",
    "Complementary accessories align when they add a recognizable capability to equipment or supplies already used."
  ],
  "WHERE_THE_SYSTEM_GETS_IT_WRONG": [
    "Broadly related items compete with closer matches despite requiring an unsupported project, device, connection, or listening preference.",
    "Recommendations repeat owned functions or overlapping content when users prefer additions that serve a distinct current purpose.",
    "Movie recommendations frequently lack an identifiable connection to recent viewing; this leaves relevance uncertain rather than establishing a content mismatch."
  ],
  "OVERUSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Broad category, brand, ecosystem, or genre similarity substitutes for matching the particular function, tone, or style users value.",
    "Past purchases of assortments, compilations, or accessories appear to generalize into interest in similar formats regardless of their contents or current usefulness."
  ],
  "UNDERUSED_OR_MISSED_DECISION_PATTERNS": [
    "Recent and repeated specific interests receive insufficient priority over older or isolated interactions.",
    "Compatibility, material, dimensions, quantity, and existing ownership determine whether a related product is actually useful.",
    "Immediate purpose and fine-grained content preferences distinguish something broadly appealing from something the user would choose now."
  ],
  "PRIMARY_FAILURE_MODE_AT_TOP_OF_LIST": "Top-ranked items too often satisfy broad relatedness while lacking the specific current purpose, compatibility, or content fit needed to motivate a choice.",
  "DIAGNOSTIC_SIGNALS_TO_TRACK": [
    "The proportion of top-ranked recommendations users would choose now, distinguished from items they merely find interesting or would defer.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to unsupported needs, incompatible specifications, excessive quantities, or redundant ownership.",
    "The frequency with which a specific recent-interest match ranks below an item supported only by broad similarity.",
    "The proportion of recommendations whose relevance users cannot assess because no recognizable connection to their history can be established."
  ]
}
